request: Add rectangular openining to the lower back of the coffee machine, which might serve as draft location for plug and main ON/OFF switch. Opening should be 20cm x 10cm and 3cm deep rectangle with roundend corners (radius 1cm). Position should be more or less equally distanced from bottom and sides of the device.

actions.operation: Create a rounded-rectangular opening extending 3 cm into the lower back of the coffee machine.
actions.target: Lower back of the coffee machine.
actions.relational_constraint: Position the opening approximately equally distanced from the bottom and the two sides of the device.
actions.unresolved_reference: Identify the coffee machine's back face, bottom boundary, and lateral side boundaries. Resolve which opening dimension is horizontal versus vertical and determine the exact placement because 'more or less equally distanced' specifies only an approximate relationship.

intention: Provide a possible location for a plug and the main ON/OFF switch.
